prompt:
Use case: precise pose and perspective correction, identity-preserve image edit.
Edit target: this full-body transparent illustration of the adult woman Yumemi, about 25, in a sailor costume. The user prefers THIS second corrected version over the earlier bent-leg version, and APPROVES THE CLOTHING. The remaining problem is that the upper body is THREE-QUARTER VIEW while the hips, skirt and legs look pasted on in FRONT VIEW.
Preserve her head, face, expression, lavender hair, hair ornament, earrings, shoulders, upper torso, hands, white sailor blouse, navy collar, lavender neckerchief and illustration style as closely as possible. Same adult, softly fuller body proportions and same outfit design.
Rebuild the LOWER BODY AS ONE COHERENT UNIT from the waist downward: rotate the pelvis, the unchanged-design pleated skirt, both thighs, knees, shins, ankles and both loafers to the SAME subtle three-quarter direction as the existing torso (roughly a quarter-turn toward the viewer's left). The skirt pleats, waist volume and hem perspective must follow the hip rotation; do not keep a flat symmetric front-view skirt over rotated legs. Do not twist the waist unnaturally.
Use a modest comfortable standing pose with the torso and pelvis aligned. Keep the legs mostly extended and anatomically natural, one carries slightly more weight; show a small depth offset between the near and far leg rather than two mirrored frontal legs. Both knees and both shoe toes point in the SAME general three-quarter direction as the pelvis and upper body. The feet are separated a little, not crossed, overlapping, pinched together or wide apart. Ground contact must be believable in perspective. Preserve gentle fuller calves and realistic adult leg lengths, with no sharp S-curves, no pronounced inward knees, no oversized calf bulges.
Keep exactly the existing costume design, skirt length and coverage, dark knee socks and brown loafers; only adjust their construction and folds to fit the corrected three-quarter pose. Do not introduce new garments or props. Do not change the upper body to front view to solve the mismatch.
Polished anime visual novel cutout matching the input. One character only, portrait approximately 1024x1536, entire hair and both shoes visible with margins, comparable character scale. No diagrams, labels, text, watermark or extra head panels.
Genuine transparent alpha background. No painted background, halo, glow, shadow, floor or checkerboard.
